COMPOSITION: interacting groups: fr_catastrophe_noun, fr_volcanique_adj: the cone drips into the pig's bowl while a separate round crater sits a step away; fr_geologique_adj, fr_creuset_noun: the layered stone wedge stands near the door and the orange pot glows on its own bench; fr_tremblement_noun, fr_pilier_noun: the jelly wobbles on a stand beside the pillar. Angled, layered foreground/middle/back; varied facing, scale and box-bottom heights. Neither a lineup nor two bands nor a grid; no isolated display of gags. Read as one scene with labels removed. Distinguish these siblings: the rock hall; the chemistry lab; the open court. No people. The pig stays inside the left group. The sloth stays on the pillar. Empty floor between every pair of stands.

ITEMS: exactly 6 concepts, each with its entire recognizable sound cue and meaning visible together. Near-synonym items stay visually unambiguous and do not share a shape:
1. catastrophe = catastrophe: chosen hook A tiny cone spills red syrup into a pig's bowl: a small CATASTROPHE.; literal cue the bowl of red syrup; shown as a cone, a low bowl, and one pig; pose/action the pig stands at the bowl; syrup runs from the cone; count -; at left, left floor, foreground; interacts with its own stand; planned pixel envelope [60, 300, 240, 280].

3. géologique = geological: chosen hook GEOLOGICAL layers stripe a stone wedge.; literal cue the striped stone wedge; shown as one gray wedge with three rock bands on a low stand; pose/action the wedge stands on the stand; count -; at center, center floor, foreground; interacts with the empty floor; planned pixel envelope [700, 470, 160, 160].

PLACEMENT AND SPACING: feminine noun centers left of 45%, masculine right of 55%; adjectives, adverbs, and epicene nouns (article le/la) in the central 30%-70% band. No dividing line. Whole item plus helper fits one tight nonoverlapping box, at least 77 px from the left and right edges and 43 px from the top and bottom (6%). Leave about 110 px between neighboring long labels and space below each item for its label. Do not hide key props.

DOORS AND EXITS: to cour, back center, painted as one brown paneled wooden door, open, telescope on the gravel beyond. Clear floor-level thresholds at human scale; no props in openings. Beyond: gravel and the white telescope on its black tripod and round plinth. Match the destination's actual appearance from its attached image, including materials and silhouette; a style reference must not replace them. Reciprocal door design; plausible stairs and outdoor paths. Paint a door only when both ends show that opening. Do not invent a door into an accepted room that has none. A glimpse through an opening shows that room's real floor, walls, and the exhibits the facing direction would see, and it adds no exit the room does not have. One door leaf, not two. Match the attached brown paneled door and the telescope. GROUNDING AND ANATOMY: held, mounted or supported props with contact shadows; no floating controls. Correct heads, limbs, hands, fingers and faces; hands connect to their own shoulders. No duplicates, merged bodies or severed parts.

FIGURES: word figures and their named helpers are distinct and recognizable. Background figures participate plainly, without separate gags or confusing props. Helpers never dominate their item. Animals behave naturally unless the hook explicitly requires otherwise. A model, toy, or figurine cue sits at object scale on the shared surface with the people. It is not a life-size animal or a landscape.

TEXT: only declared natural scene text none. Blank sign plates: one blank plaque, no letters. No item captions, garbled lettering, speech bubbles, stray symbols or digits competing with counts. Labels are added by the site.

CONTENT: all ages; no crude humor, drinking, smoking, child romance, unsafe children or costume stereotypes. Alcohol/tobacco only closed untouched objects, with no children nearby. Grave/mature terms use plaques. Sacred subjects reverent: no depiction of God the Father, no whimsical props touching sacred things. Harmless playful hooks are welcome.

VARIETY: do not repeat existing hook motifs the elephant, the laboratory rat, the purple crystal. This room differs by separate specimen stands, not the rock hall and not the chemistry bench.

AVOID: pasted-on figures, seams, lineup, shelves of separate gags, repeated motifs, blocked doors, clipped hooks, amber cast, stray text, floating props, merged or extra limbs, unexplained figures.
